description: LangChain prompt templates used in the parent_child_rag pipeline.

chunker.description: Two-layer Parent-Child (Small-to-Large) chunking. Parent chunks capture full narrative sections and are stored in an in-memory dict. Child chunks are sub-segments embedded into the vector store with parent_id metadata.
chunker.index: Only child chunks are embedded with OpenAIEmbeddings(model='text-embedding-3-small'). Each child chunk's metadata contains parent_id pointing back to its parent text.

reranker.description: BGE Cross-Encoder — scores (query, child_chunk) pairs. Top-3 scoring child chunks trigger the Context Swap step.

context_swap.description: For each top-n child chunk, parent_id metadata is used to look up the full parent text from the in-memory parent_store dict. Duplicate parent IDs are skipped. The unique parent texts are joined as the final LLM context window.

rag_qa_template.description: Main QA prompt — receives the swapped-in parent chunk context and the user query (chat mode via ChatAnthropic).
rag_qa_template.notes:
context = unique parent chunk texts joined with '

---

'. question = raw user query string.
